title: What is the central governance principle for world models?
summary: Govern according to deployment consequences, not merely the model label.
body: Safeguards should track operational function and real-world consequences. The closer a system comes to safety-critical simulation or real-world action, the more stringent evaluation, oversight and governance should become.
